sre-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: tenant=cedar | pool=dedicated-pool-3 | symptom=high tail latency on text-gen endpoints | sev=P2 | started=2026-03-15T07:02:47Z

maria: I'm taking this. quick top-line?

sre-bot: 99th pct latency > 3.5s for /v1/generate (token-gen). Token throughput ~3x baseline for Cedar over last 6m. Queue depth per worker >200. Other tenants in pool show normal latencies.

liam: checking logs — cedar submitted many long-context requests (seq_len > 2048) plus a couple of large batched rerank jobs. model=rw-4b-std, quant=8bit.

devon: sounds like head-of-line blocking from huge max batch tokens. what's their tenant profile?

liam: profile shows max_batch_tokens=2048, concurrency_limit=20, soft_throttle=off.

aparna: propose temporary surgical changes: lower max_batch_tokens -> 512 and concurrency_limit -> 6, isolate cedar's queue (shedder) to avoid affecting co-tenants, and add a short rate-limit at edge. We should do staged ramp.

maria: agreed. plan: 2048 -> 1024 (observe 2m) -> 512 if p99 still >1.5s. I'll apply via schedulerctl and post outputs. Notifying CS to tell Cedar support we're mitigating.

maria:
```bash
# apply first stage
schedulerctl set-tenant --tenant cedar --param max_batch_tokens=1024 --param concurrency_limit=10 --comment "emergency oncall mitigation"
```

ops-note: command executed by maria at 2026-03-15T07:06:12Z

sre-bot: CONFIG_ACK: schedulerctl accepted change (txid=tx-98765). Applying to dedicated-pool-3 shards.

liam: telemetry: p99 fell from 3.7s -> 2.1s within 90s after 1024 change. queue depth dropping. good sign. proceed to 512?

maria: proceeding to 512 now. will also enable tenant-level prefix KV caching override to reduce repeated compute for common prefixes.

maria:
```bash
schedulerctl set-tenant --tenant cedar --param max_batch_tokens=512 --param concurrency_limit=6
internalctl cache override --tenant cedar --prefix-kv enabled
```

ops-note: 512 applied at 2026-03-15T07:10:38Z; kv-cache override enabled.

devon: watch out — smaller batches increase token API unit cost but reduce tail. we should track cost delta and make it part of handoff.

liam: after 512 change p99 -> 0.95s, p50 ~120ms. queue depth normalized. errors down. no effect observed for other tenants.

aparna: CS update: pinged Cedar (acct: cedar-corp) at 07:12Z, they confirm a drop in timeout errors on their side. They asked if this is permanent or temporary; told them we will follow up after stabilization.

maria: I'll prepare the handoff doc for night oncall. ken, you're on for the next shift — please monitor p99 and token throughput for cedar; escalation if p99 > 3s or queue depth spikes >150 per worker. contacts: liam/devon for runtime changes; aparna for customer comms.

ken: ack. will take over monitoring. any runbook steps noted?

maria: runbook excerpt pasted below:
- symptom: sustained tenant-specific tail latency on dedicated pools
- immediate mitigations: staged reduce `max_batch_tokens` (2048 -> 1024 -> 512), reduce `concurrency_limit`, enable tenant prefix-KV caching override, apply per-tenant edge rate-limit if needed
- commands: see schedulerctl/internalctl above
- rollback: restore previous params if customer complains about regression in throughput/cost; escalate to runtime for alternative model-size routing

sre-bot: MONITOR: 30m after mitigation p99 stable ~0.9s, throughput ~70% of prior burst. No errors in infra logs. Marking incident as mitigated; keeping incident open for 12h watch.

maria: Post-incident actions: 1) capture exact knob deltas and timestamped metrics, 2) add an automatic policy to reduce max_batch_tokens when per-tenant seq_len_rate > X, 3) consider default tenant profile change or recommendation to CS for heavy long-context jobs.

devon: I'll open a follow-up RFC to propose an auto-sculpt policy with knobs and cost-accounting.

liam: adding metric dashboards + alert tuned to detect tenant-specific queue skew so future events hit earlier.

aparna: CS will offer Cedar a suggested config and explain cost tradeoffs; request permission before making permanent changes.

ken: handoff received. monitoring alerts subscribed. thanks team. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: resolved_by=maria, mitigations=staged_max_batch_tokens_change,kvcache_override,tenant_queue_isolation,watch_period=12h, status=mitigated
